candidate_status: Awaiting Tom's review · used in the family release
method: Exact GLTFLoader; all exported skin vertices at 60 Hz; SkeletonUtils clone; actual src/game/enemy-animation.ts. Rotation-only joints are checked as fixed local pivots; the hips (bob, pounce travel, seated defeat) and hat (pop/slide) are the intentional translations. No physical-device or universal triangle-collision proof (the Blender attachment audit covers listed part pairs).
note: glTF axes: +Y up, character faces -Z; its right (the tail side) is +X. Root at the floor origin under the body centre.
